data.one_liner: Flutter widget to easily create breadcrumbs and navigational trails.
data.what_it_does: Provides a BreadCrumb widget and builder pattern to display hierarchical navigation paths with custom dividers and overflow behaviors like wrapping or scrolling.
use_when: You need to display a breadcrumb navigation trail in your Flutter app.
You want support for custom overflow handling like wrapping or scrolling breadcrumb items.
avoid_when: You require complex automatic routing integration out of the box.
strengths: Provides built-in overflow behaviors including wrap and scroll, plus custom overflow options.
weaknesses: Limited to visual presentation of breadcrumbs without automatic deep route mapping.
data.minimal_example:
BreadCrumb(
	items: <BreadCrumbItem>[
		 BreadCrumbItem(content: Text('Item1')),
		 BreadCrumbItem(content: Text('Item2')),
	],
	divider: Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
)
